exercise.title: Do Re Mi on the beat
exercise.why: A step up and back is the shape most tunes start with, and the metronome shows whether your voice gets to each note on time.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone, the metronome and the mic start together. Sing {{1}} {{2}} {{3}} {{2}} {{1}} on the note names, one note per beat.
When every note lands on the beat, try a faster stage. Use the Stage selector below to change the tempo, then press Start exercise to start the metronome again.
If a stage is too fast, go back one and sing it on "oo".
